verdict.rationale: Vapi's pricing page confirms a published usage-based model: free to start, then pay only for the minutes that run. That makes per-minute billing explicit. The evidence gives no actual per-minute rates, no breakdown of costs across model, voice and telephony providers, and no calculator or way to estimate cost per call before committing. missing for 10: published per-minute dollar rates, provider and component cost breakdown, a cost-per-call estimator or worked examples, independent corroboration of real-world call costs.
